title: Ensure GPG check is globally activated
fix: Set gpgcheck=1 in applicable package repository configuration.

title: Disable SSH root login
fix: Set PermitRootLogin no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file, validate, then restart ssh.

title: Disable users' core dumps
fix: Add '* hard core 0' to /etc/security/limits.conf.

title: Prevent direct root logins
fix: Make /etc/securetty empty and use an approved non-root administrative account.

title: Configure PAM password quality
fix: Configure pam_pwquality.so in /etc/pam.d/common-password.

title: Limit password reuse
fix: Configure an approved remember value in the PAM pwhistory module.

title: Restrict kernel pointer exposure
fix: Set kernel.kptr_restrict=2 in /etc/sysctl.d/ and run sysctl --system.

title: Set SSH idle timeout
fix: Set ClientAliveInterval 600 and ClientAliveCountMax 0 in the SSH server configuration.

title: Disable SSH login with empty passwords
fix: Set PermitEmptyPasswords no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart ssh.

title: Disable SSH host-based authentication
fix: Set HostbasedAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart ssh.

title: Disable accounts after password expiration
fix: Set INACTIVE to the approved inactive-account period in /etc/default/useradd.

title: Enable the audit daemon
check: systemctl is-enabled auditd && systemctl is-active auditd
fix: Install auditd if absent, then run systemctl enable --now auditd.

title: Configure audit log space warning
fix: Set admin_space_left and admin_space_left_action in /etc/audit/auditd.conf according to policy.

title: Install AppArmor
fix: Run apt-get install -y apparmor apparmor-utils.

title: Enable AppArmor from GRUB
fix: Add apparmor=1 security=apparmor to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX and run update-grub.

title: Enable automatic security updates
fix: Configure unattended-upgrades and periodic update settings.

title: Disable IPv4 source routing
fix: Set net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route=0 in /etc/sysctl.d/ and run sysctl --system.

title: Disable IPv6 router advertisements
fix: Set net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra=0 in /etc/sysctl.d/ and run sysctl --system.

title: Configure SSH keepalive settings
fix: Set ClientAliveInterval and ClientAliveCountMax in /etc/ssh/sshd_config according to policy.

title: Enable the host firewall
check: systemctl is-enabled ufw; systemctl is-active ufw
fix: Install and enable ufw after defining required inbound rules.
